source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Door heights assumed 2.1m pending elevation evidence.
Window heights assumed sill 1.0m to head 2.0m pending elevation evidence.
Ceiling height assumed 3.0m pending elevation evidence.
Interior partitions modeled as centerlines without explicit thickness, consistent with plan_partition lightweight scope.
Door swing arcs used to estimate ~900mm door apertures for corridor doors where exact wall gap was partly occluded by symbols.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
Interior corridor door heights assumed 2.1m absolute (2F floor base+2.1), not shown on any facade (interior partitions).

Window z heights combine North/West/East elevation evidence (sill1.0m/head2.8m above 2F floor) added to an assumed z_floor=3.0m for this draft-local placement; actual assembled z will be corrected by assemble_plan_bim floor-base translation using this draft's LOCAL z (see note: this draft was built with z_floor=0 so opening z here should be LOCAL not absolute -- see unresolved).
Ceiling height 3.6m and floor2 base 3.0m taken from North_view.png/West_view.png overall 6600mm total split 3000(1F)+3600(2F).
Partition walls modeled as centerlines without explicit thickness.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: North_view.png dimension chain clearly locates F1 window height family; consistent with visual window symbols on all facades.

claims.reason: North_view.png right-side vertical dimension chain descends from building top (z=6.6m, total height 6600mm) to ground (z=0): 800,1800,1000 for the 2F zone (top 3600mm) then 400,1600,1000 for the 1F zone (bottom 3000mm). Reading direction -1 from origin 6.6m: cumulative points are 6.6,5.8,4.0,3.0,2.6,1.0,0.0. The 1F window (1600mm segment, zero-based segment index 4) spans absolute z 1.0 to 2.6m. This single elevation chain applies to all F1 exterior windows (north, south and east facades), which share the same storey and typical window size per the drawing.
unresolved: Assumes all F1 exterior windows share this single measured height family; not individually re-measured on South/East/West_view.png beyond visual consistency check.

decision.reason: North_view.png dimension chain confirms F2 window height family already used.

claims.reason: North_view.png right-side vertical dimension chain descends from building top (z=6.6m) to ground (z=0): 800,1800,1000 (2F zone) then 400,1600,1000 (1F zone). Direction -1 from origin 6.6m gives cumulative points 6.6,5.8,4.0,3.0,2.6,1.0,0.0. The 2F window (1800mm segment, zero-based segment index 1) spans absolute z 4.0 to 5.8m, matching the value already used when this floor draft was built. This confirms/documents that existing value against the elevation.
unresolved: Assumes all F2 exterior windows share this single measured height family (matches South/East/West_view.png visual pattern).
